sections.body: The final inspection compares the completed work with the records, returned tools, and vehicle condition. Perform a function test only when assigned and authorized. A road test requires the workshop's procedure and a driver with the appropriate valid license. This learning material does not grant permission to drive.
sections.title: Work Concepts and Standards

sections.body: Inspect the serviced parts, make sure no tools are left behind, and check the relevant indicators. Record any unfinished work. Do not drive a customer's vehicle unless assigned and properly licensed; ask authorized staff to arrange a function test.

lessons.title: Final Inspection and Function Testing

sections.body: A hold mark prevents use of a vehicle until its risks have been assessed. A useful report identifies the vehicle, location, visible condition, time, any measurement, and temporary action. Report facts, not assumptions. The person in charge decides on repairs, reinspection, and who may continue the work.
sections.title: Work Concepts and Standards

sections.body: If there is a leak, damaged cable, unusual noise, missing part, or result outside the manual's limits, stop the affected step and mark it. Tell the workshop leader directly. Do not remove the mark or close the record until a decision and inspection have been made.

sections.body: Records link the vehicle, complaint, inspection, parts, results, and follow-up. Use part numbers and actual quantities; keep used, new, and pending-inspection parts separate. Keep customer information confidential and share it only with authorized people.
